source.snippet: Meta Ran Ads That Contained AI-Generated Child Sexual Abuse Imagery. Comment: 'Yeah, like $5 per unique ad would be basically nothing but it would pay for plenty of review.' — suggesting willingness to pay for ad content moderation/review tooling at scale.

problem_statement: Ad platforms and brands need affordable, scalable pre-publication review of AI-generated ad creatives to catch policy-violating or brand-unsafe content before it goes live, but no cheap per-unit review service exists.
target_segment: Digital advertising agencies, brand safety teams at mid-to-large advertisers, ad network compliance teams
notes: Commenter explicitly frames $5/ad as trivially affordable for review — implicit buyer signal from someone in the ad ecosystem. Pain is real (major platform incident) but only a single data point here.
